operation_details.item: The user facilitated the operating-model workshop.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the operating-model work coming along today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty well. I facilitated the operating-model workshop, and the leadership team stayed engaged throughout.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Did the discussion stay practical, or drift into the usual abstract strategy language?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Mostly practical. We focused on where handoffs get stuck and what could actually change. The facilitation guide is prepared, so I can reuse the useful parts for the next session.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds more useful than forcing everything into a polished framework. Are you already pulling the takeaways together?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the synthesis report is in progress. I’m keeping it grounded in the workshop discussion rather than overcomplicating it.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I facilitated the operating-model workshop; keep the facilitation guide, attendees, and synthesis report.
